professionalSummary: Experienced retail refit project manager with a proven record of delivering 14 store refits in 2023‑2024, managing scope, contractors, phasing and handover for Marlow & Finch Homewares.
Demonstrated ability to keep stores trading safely during works through detailed phasing plans, hoarding and out‑of‑hours delivery coordination.
Certified PRINCE2 Practitioner with a recognised project‑management qualification.
Strong stakeholder engagement with store operations, contractors and programme leadership.

evidence.text: Managed 14 store refits in 2023 and 2024 for Marlow & Finch Homewares, from the scope agreed with store operations to the handover walk with each store manager.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of portfolio management from scope to handover.

evidence.text: Ran tenders for fit-out contractors, set up the contracts and held weekly site meetings on programme, cost and variations, closing each project's final account.
evidence.notes: Supports contractor management and handover closure.

evidence.text: Ran tenders for fit-out contractors, set up the contracts and held weekly site meetings on programme, cost and variations, closing each project's final account.

evidence.text: Phased the works so that every store stayed open, agreeing hoarding lines, out-of-hours deliveries and fire routes with the store manager and the contractor's site lead.
evidence.notes: Shows safe trading during works through phasing and site rules.

evidence.text: The programme director at Marlow & Finch Homewares confirmed in writing that the candidate was on site at stores across England and Wales for two to three nights most weeks during 2023 and 2024, matching the company's travel and expenses records.
evidence.notes: Confirms on‑site presence two nights a week.
